The '''Bovo Yagen system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kailion sector/Legends|Kailion sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Centered around the star [[Bovo Yagen (star)|Bovo Yagen]], the system's planets and belt were named for the being [[Bovo Yagen]] and his [[Yagen family|children]]. The population of the system was uncertain with one estimate placing it at twelve million.

The system was scheduled to be the next target to destroyed by [[Centerpoint Station]] in the [[Corellian Crisis|Starbuster Plot]], but was narrowly saved by young [[Anakin Solo]].
